coordinate_contract.ordering: ordered painting; later rectangles win at every overlapping cell

style_guide.aesthetic: Volcanic geology rendered as a damaged geological observatory; not a metal factory or crystalline ice cathedral
style_guide.dominant: BasaltColumns 100, Obsidian 101; large black solids with clear isolated holes
style_guide.heat_colours: Firebrick 104, RedBrick 43, TerracottaTile 48, SulfurBlock 126; yellow used for fan-shaped deposits
style_guide.highlights: NeonAmber 79 as inert optical illusion; QuartzCrystal 122/GlassBlock 120 as translucent edges
style_guide.dynamic_accent: optional Lava 8, MoltenGlass 36 and Steam 22 are physically active; scene uses inert swaps
style_guide.composition: An asymmetric, fractured diadem of stratified basalt crowns the open cooled fumarole. Its western cross-beds and sheared eastern mantle enclose a deliberately absent keystone; broken quench ledgers, fused quartz pendants and unequal scree aprons connect the crown to the eight intact dry modules. The alternate inverted kiln remains unchanged.
style_guide.negative_space: preserve at least 40% legible void; no painted background layer behind passage gaps
style_guide.seams: repeating low terraces align at common ground; never mirror or rotate unvalidated paths
style_guide.palette_rule: limit bright yellow/amber to thin readable seams, not whole-field fills
style_guide.scale: authored at 1 native cell per coordinate; large-scene offsets integer only

features.title: Fracture stair / black-red strata
features.role: Low fractured terrace with warm terracotta seams cut through black volcanic rock
features.orientation: authored 0 degrees; no inferred rotation or mirroring
neighbour_rules: Join only with another dry ground piece at a matching low shelf
Keep 10 empty cells above the highest spur
Do not bury ochre fracture edges under a neighboring foundation
features.simulation_notes: All solids are fixed kernel-None materials. Visual stratification is not a stress fracture or thermal process.

features.title: Sulfur blossom / stepped mineral fan
features.role: Asymmetric yellow petals emerging from a black mineral mound with pale lime tips
features.orientation: authored 0 degrees; no inferred rotation or mirroring
neighbour_rules: Avoid placing beside a second rosette within 100 cells to keep focal uniqueness
May butt against the fracture terrace when its base is at the same y
No hot material must be assumed to originate from mineral colour
features.simulation_notes: SulfurBlock is a fixed inert building material on pinned main, not a sulfur gas emitter.

features.title: Hollow caldera iris
features.role: A keyed lava-like halo around an actual void with amber insets, never an active lava source
features.orientation: authored 0 degrees; no inferred rotation or mirroring
neighbour_rules: Leave opening x38..73,y31..63 unpainted and explicitly clear host material before staging
Do not put a person or Rapier body in the opening until clearance and contact are checked
Preserve 8 cells around its upper crown
features.simulation_notes: Gap is visual empty space in a drawing and will not carve existing terrain; opening is not known to be traversable. Fixed material ring is not a rigid body.

features.title: Vitreous fall / glass thread cascade
features.role: High stepped glass hood and narrow molten-glass streaks feeding an obsidian basin
features.orientation: authored 0 degrees; no inferred rotation or mirroring
neighbour_rules: Native liquid may move and cool; isolate from Water and Lava until interaction fixtures exist
Leave open downstream capture zone unless containment has been tested
Gallery must use quenched-glass or glass-archive
features.simulation_notes: MoltenGlass 36 is a moving CellularYield liquid with a cooling kernel and eventual conversion to Glass. The drawn shape is t=0 only. Water contact emits Steam and Glass under pair rules.

variants.note: Static chilled glass columns; gallery default

features.title: Tall fumarole throat / steam crown
features.role: Slit-sided stone chimney and a pale rising plume; crystalline ghost variant for dry galleries
features.orientation: authored 0 degrees; no inferred rotation or mirroring
neighbour_rules: Only stage dynamic version with an open upward gas escape corridor
Never enclose the steam behind an authoring fill without a gas test
Its ghost variant is not traversable white mist; quartz cells are solid
features.simulation_notes: Steam 22 is a rising movable gas with native kernel. Emission or ongoing generation is NOT provided by this pack; isolated t=0 plume dissipates/moves.

variants.note: Fixed quartz breath silhouette; gallery default
Completely empty chimney; stage ID 0 erasure only on approved clear pass

features.title: Lava-eye reliquary / shallow caldera pool
features.role: Asymmetric volcanic sump with an inner lava lens; dry variant preserves heat contrast without liquid
features.orientation: authored 0 degrees; no inferred rotation or mirroring
neighbour_rules: Do not place Water or GlassBlock at the live pool; source pairs cause quenching/melting
Do not assume basin leak-free, heat-safe or pressure-safe until native ticks run

features.simulation_notes: Lava 8 uses the moving Lava kernel and CellularYield; native rules include Lava/Water quench and probabilistic Lava/Obsidian conversion. Basin walls use BasaltColumns 100/Firebrick 104; apparent containment is unqualified.

variants.note: Static terracotta enamel with no active Lava

features.title: Cooled black skerry / accreted glass shelves

features.orientation: authored 0 degrees; no inferred rotation or mirroring
neighbour_rules: Place between at least two taller features for a low-rest measure

Allow 10+ empty cells above its jagged crest
features.simulation_notes: GlassBlock is solid kernel None. A visually delicate shard does not have fracture, optics or joint simulation.

features.title: Heatward stela / amber witness marker

features.orientation: authored 0 degrees; no inferred rotation or mirroring
neighbour_rules: At most one stela per 220 horizontal cells in a showcase
Require a grounded foot at least 80 cells wide
Amber is fixed NeonAmber material, not an actual light/temperature sensor

scene.title: THE EMBERGLASS SCAR — THE BROKEN CALDERA DIADEM
scene.status: inert source-colour gallery; no gameplay or thermal acceptance
scene.placement_order: terrain first, then listed feature rectangles; last write wins; no parallel layers
scene.description:
The dry broken caldera crown now carries two shear-aligned hanging roof flanks, a fractured thermograph halo, collapsed inspection gantry and fixed mineral inscription details; these are illustrative source-colour materials only.
Four dry illustrative, genuinely unwritten stepped undercrofts: mineral ossuary, broken kiln assay, vitrified archive and eroded heatward ledger. No host clearing or native behavior admitted.
